rules.title: Fair Chance Ordinance (affordable housing)
rules.requirement: In San Francisco, the Fair Chance Ordinance protects people with arrest or conviction records when they apply for affordable housing.
rules.requirement_es: En San Francisco, la Ordenanza de Oportunidad Justa protege a las personas con antecedentes de arresto o condena cuando solicitan vivienda asequible.
rules.coverage_text: Affordable housing decisions in San Francisco. This page only summarizes the ordinance and does not give its code section or details.
rules.quote: San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance protects residents with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions.
